mapper.sql: v.id, v.workspace_id, v.sequence_id, v.version_number, v.definition_json, v.definition_hash, publisher.published_by_id, v.created_at
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version_number), 0) + 1 FROM sequence_version WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND sequence_id = #{sequenceId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sequence_version (workspace_id, sequence_id, version_number, definition_json, definition_hash) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{sequenceId}, #{versionNumber}, #{definitionJson}, #{definitionHash})
INSERT INTO sequence_version_publisher (workspace_id, version_id, published_by_id) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{versionId}, #{publishedById})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sequence_version v LEFT JOIN sequence_version_publisher publisher ON publisher.workspace_id = v.workspace_id AND publisher.version_id = v.id WHERE v.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND v.sequence_id = #{sequenceId} ORDER BY v.version_number DESC
